tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Use when a city, region or island name has to be turned into a place_id (needed by search_hotels, get_hotel_facts and get_price_guide): returns up to 5 matching places with place_id and country. If several fit, choose by country or ask the user.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Use when the user wants hotels at a place with specific features (pool, sauna, pets allowed …). All given amenities must match, as stated by the hotels; with few or no results, try fewer amenities.
